Global (Worldwide).description: Worldwide total active fire events aggregated across all continents.

South America (Amazon & Cerrado).description: Amazon basin deforestation fires and Cerrado biome savannah burning.

Central & Southern Africa.description: Agricultural stubble, pasture management, and Miombo woodland burning.

Australia & Oceania.description: Northern Territory savannah burning and catastrophic Black Summer bushfires (2019-2020).

North America (Western US & Canada).description: California wildfires, Pacific Northwest, and historic 2023 Canadian boreal blazes.

Southeast Asia & Indochina.description: Agricultural clearing, peatland fires, and seasonal deciduous forest burning.

Europe & Mediterranean.description: Southern Europe summer heatwave fires in Greece, Spain, Portugal, and Italy.
